Asha (Support): Sam from AcmeStream reporting errors on embeddings endpoint after switching to batched requests. They see a 400 with `dimension mismatch` on ~30% of requests and a huge billing spike from retries. Sample error: `400 Bad Request - expected dim 1536 but got 2048`

Sam (AcmeStream): +1, hit this in prod around 09:10 UTC. We started batching 8 docs per request. Looks like some vectors returned with 2048 dims. No change on our side other than batching.

Asha (Support): Thanks Sam. Can you paste a redacted request (headers + body) and one full response with the error? Also any trace_id you got back?

Sam (AcmeStream): Here's the repro curl (sanitized):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large-1536","input":["doc1","doc2","doc3","doc4","doc5","doc6","doc7","doc8"]}'
```

And one error chunk they captured: `{"error":"dimension mismatch","expected":1536,"got":2048,"trace_id":"trc_0a9b3c"}`

Ben (Infra): @Asha can you share the proxy/batcher logs for that timeframe? I want to see whether requests were routed to a different model variant. Also any recent config rollouts to batching-service?

Asha (Support): grabbing logs now. Attaching anonymized log snippet: 

```
[09:09:59] batcher.receive req_id=R-11 size=8 model_alias=embed-large
[09:09:59] model-resolve req_id=R-11 resolved_model=embed-large@v3 -> embed-large-2048
[09:09:59] forward req_id=R-11 target=runtime-42
[09:10:00] runtime.reply req_id=R-11 success=false error=dimension_mismatch expected=1536 got=2048 trace_id=trc_0a9b3c
```

Carmen (Eng): interesting — logs show batcher resolved alias to a 2048-dim variant (`embed-large-2048`). That explains the mismatch. We should never return a variant with different output dim for an alias consumers expect. Possible causes: alias mapping table got stale / a model onboarding step incorrectly registered a wrong-dim variant under the same alias.

Dylan (Observability): do we have a trace for `trc_0a9b3c`? I want to see span-level latency (queueing, batch-assemble, model-infer, network). If we don't have fine-grained spans on the embeddings route, we should add them — this will help customers surface whether the problem is routing vs model behavior.

Asha (Support): I pulled the trace from X-Ray: `https://traces.internal/trace/trc_0a9b3c` (redacted link). Summary: most of the time is model_infer 18ms, batch_queue 12ms, total end-to-end ~36ms. But multiple similar traces show model variant mismatches occasionally.

Carmen (Eng): I dug into model registry changes — there was a manual onboarding yesterday that added `embed-large-2048` as an internal test variant, and the alias conflict check failed to block it due to a schema meta mismatch. Patch idea: enforce strict dimension compatibility when resolving aliases and add a guard in batcher.resolve to drop incompatible variants. Quick fix I can push: compare registry.dimensions[alias] to candidate.dim and fail resolution if mismatch.

Ben (Infra): Recommend immediate mitigation: temporarily disable auto-alias switching and set alias to pinned `embed-large-1536` until patch rolls. Also throttle client concurrency for AcmeStream to reduce retries (they're hitting rate limit / retry loop causing billing spike). I can flip alias pin and apply rate-limit override.

Carmen (Eng): I can open a small PR with the guard. Patch diff (excerpt):

```
# in batcher/resolve.py
candidate = registry.get(candidate_name)
if candidate.dim != registry.get_alias_dim(alias):
    raise AliasResolveError("dimension mismatch on alias resolution")
```

Carmen (Eng): I'll also add an automated regression test in model-registry tests to ensure alias -> variant dims match.

deploy-bot: started deploy 2026-03-15T10:05:00Z - job=batcher/alias-dim-guard (#2741)

Dylan (Observability): Once the guard is live we should add two observability items before closing this thread: 1) per-request latency breakdown in the embeddings route dashboard with spans: queue, assemble_batch, model_infer, net_e2e; 2) add a trace-sampling rule for embeddings errors to keep 100% sampling for 5m after an error to capture root causes. I'll make a dashboard patch and a sampling rule.

Asha (Support): Noted. Sam, we're going to pin your alias to the known-good `embed-large-1536` and push the guard. Ben will throttle retries for your key to avoid the billing spike. Carmen will deploy the guard and tests. Dylan will update dashboards/tracing. We'll verify with you after.

Sam (AcmeStream): Thank you — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please keep me posted. Our SRE team is standing by if you need more logs.

Ben (Infra): Done: pinned alias `embed-large` -> `embed-large-1536` for customer key=acct-acme-01 at 09:57 UTC. Also applied temporary client concurrency limit: max_concurrent=4.

deploy-bot: deploy finished batcher/alias-dim-guard (#2741) - success - 10:12 UTC

Carmen (Eng): Patch live. Added registry guard + test. Also added a short-lived alert: `alias_dimension_mismatch_count > 0` -> P0 Pager.

Dylan (Observability): Dashboard PR: `embeddings/route_latency_breakdown` updated to include spans and per-model dims. Trace sampling rule created: `sample_if(span.error OR route==embeddings) ttl=5m priority=high`.

Asha (Support): Sam — can you re-run the same batched curl and paste any errors (if any) and a fresh trace id? We'll monitor for 30m.

Sam (AcmeStream): Re-ran at 10:22 UTC. No 400s observed in the 120 requests we tried. Trace id example: `trc_0a9b9f`.

Asha (Support): Great — closing the loop. We'll keep the pin for 24h and then coordinate a controlled alias switch with tests. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Carmen (Eng): Follow-ups: create a migration job to scan registry for alias dim inconsistencies and run weekly; add an integration test for batcher that simulates mixed-dim registry entry.

Ben (Infra): I'll leave the throttles in place for 2 hours, then relax if metrics look OK. Posting monitoring query: `rate(errors{route="embeddings",reason="dimension_mismatch"}[5m])` — currently 0.

Dylan (Observability): Added a short note in the embeddings dashboard description: "If you see sporadic dimension_mismatch errors, check model-registry alias -> variant dims and recent onboarding jobs."

Asha (Support): Marking this thread resolved for now. Reopen if Sam sees recurrence. :eyes:
